object.attr: Running energy cost grows with speed. The speed is the current speed, 3600 divided by the current pace in s/km, and 0 km/h when the current pace is 0. Basis: as implemented.
object.description: For Run, the app shall use a metabolic equivalent of 6.0 from 0 km/h, 8.3 from 6 km/h, 9.8 from 8 km/h, 11.0 from 9.7 km/h, 11.8 from 11.3 km/h and 12.8 from 12.9 km/h.
